Otherwise position increments, previous direction reloads, phase resets0. Phase8 commits the tile before subpixel motion. DWORD BCD5E8 is cleared on every return, including nonpositive substep count.
algorithms.004b33d0: Positive route reads a serialized byte or releases an exhausted route and selects8. Nonpositive route computes the actual eight-way heading from signed WORD actor/target coordinates, writes its AL to direction, then replaces direction with10 when AL!=8.
algorithms.004b3530: Full water/usage/terrain/building and bridge-gate logic. Bridge result1 checks actual queue fullness and both signed occupancies, enqueues the address of the actor stack slot, reloads that actor after the call, sets state7, releases the route and clears the freshly loaded building owner's WORD. Unavailable bridge relocates after route release and changes actor state/lifecycle by the native type table. Reproducible original-bit audit of132 direct calls found129 without direct semantic consumption before overwrite, another direct call or return; partial AL/AX replacements and internal LEA transformations are tracked without treating them as full EAX kills. limitations: 4B2D20 route builder, 4BAA10 broad service, 4AD880 relocation search, 4B3470 bridge lookahead, 4B1210 collision and 4690F0 terrain effect are explicit typed controlled oracle endpoints. Their production algorithms remain outside this phase; 4B3FF0 alternate movement is also outside scope.

Fixtures use prepared serialized routes, mapped records, queues and bounded initially acyclic grid lists. A direct single-operation case preserves the native self-append quirk. No path-finding completeness, actual service success, whole actor-controller correctness or city pixel fidelity is claimed.
